description:
Scholarship Overview

The Berlin Graduate School of Ancient Studies (BerGSAS) is offering 3 predoc scholarships at Freie Universität Berlin in 2027 in the field of Ancient Studies. Funding is available from 1 March 2027 onwards for up to 6 months. An extension is not possible. You receive a scholarship of EUR 1,000 per month.

Purpose of the Predoc Scholarship

The purpose of the predoc scholarship is to develop a dissertation topic as well as to submit an application to scholarship providers (e.g., Elsa Neumann Scholarship; Gerda Henkel Foundation; Studienstiftung des Deutschen Volkes) within the 6-month funding period. It is expected that your doctoral dissertation will be written at and submitted to the Freie Universität. Predoc scholarship holders who successfully apply for external doctoral funding will be admitted as full members to BerGSAS and participate in the curriculum of a structured doctoral program.

Eligibility Criteria

  • At the beginning of the scholarship, you must be enrolled in either a master's program or a doctoral program at the Freie Universität Berlin.
  • Funding is available to students whose Master's thesis is completed and evaluated by 1 December 2026.
  • You must be planning to conduct and complete your doctorate at the Freie Universität Berlin, within BerGSAS.
  • When submitting your application, please specify who the potential academic supervisor of your doctoral dissertation at the Freie Universität Berlin should be. Please enclose her/his letter of confirmation.

Application Documents

  • A letter of motivation (maximum 1 page, A4)
  • A project outline for a doctoral dissertation (ca. 6,000 characters including spaces). The outline should include a title, state of research, aim/main research question, methods and material/evidence.
  • A letter of confirmation of the potential supervisor of your doctoral dissertation at FU Berlin
  • A curriculum vitae (CV, resume)
  • University transcripts: B.A. and M.A. certificates
  • English language certificate e.g., IELTS or TOEFL: C1 (only if your mother tongue is not German or English)
  • In addition, a letter of recommendation from the supervisor of your MA thesis is required. The reviewer should send the letter directly to bergsas@berliner-antike-kolleg.org.

How to Apply

Please send your application as one single PDF file to bergsas@berliner-antike-kolleg.org. Application documents in German or English, Arial 12pt, 1.5 line.

https://www.berliner-antike-kolleg.org/en/bergsas/ausschreibungen/index.html

Contact

Dr Regina Attula, regina.attula@berliner-antike-kolleg.org

Important Notes

  • Partially funded: EUR 1,000/month for up to 6 months.
  • Extension is not possible.
  • The selection committee will not consider incomplete or late applications.
  • Part of the Berlin Graduate School of Ancient Studies (BerGSAS).
